verses.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus foi para o Monte das Oliveiras.
verses.en_web: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus went to the Mountain of Olives.

verses.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.pt: Pela manhã cedo voltou ao templo, e todo o povo vinha ter com ele; e Jesus, sentando-se o ensinava.
verses.en_web: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning he came again into the Temple and all the people came to him and he was seated teaching them.

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.pt: Então os escribas e fariseus trouxeram-lhe uma mulher apanhada em adultério; e pondo-a no meio,
verses.en_web: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
verses.en_bbe: Now the scribes and Pharisees came, with a woman who had been taken in the act of sinning against the married relation;

verses.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.pt: disseram-lhe: Mestre, esta mulher foi apanhada em flagrante adultério.
verses.en_web: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
verses.en_bbe: And putting her forward, they said to him, Master, this woman has been taken in the very act of sinning against the married relation.

verses.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.pt: Ora, Moisés nos ordena na lei que as tais sejam apedrejadas. Tu, pois, que dizes?
verses.en_web: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
verses.en_bbe: Now in the law Moses gave directions that such women were to be stoned; what do you say about it?

verses.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.pt: Isto diziam eles, tentando-o, para terem de que o acusar. Jesus, porém, inclinando-se, começou a escrever no chão com o dedo.
verses.en_web: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.en_bbe: They said this, testing him, so that they might have something against him. But Jesus, with his head bent down, made letters on the floor with his finger.

verses.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.pt: Mas, como insistissem em perguntar-lhe, ergueu-se e disse- lhes: Aquele dentre vós que está sem pecado seja o primeiro que lhe atire uma pedra.
verses.en_web: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
verses.en_bbe: But when they went on with their questions, he got up and said to them, Let him among you who is without sin be the first to send a stone at her.

verses.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.pt: E, tornando a inclinar-se, escrevia na terra.
verses.en_web: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
verses.en_bbe: And again, with bent head, he made letters on the floor.

verses.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.pt: Quando ouviram isto foram saindo um a um, a começar pelos mais velhos, até os últimos; ficou só Jesus, e a mulher ali em pé.
verses.en_web: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
verses.en_bbe: And when his words came to their ears, they went out one by one, starting with the oldest even to the last, because they were conscious of what was in their hearts: and Jesus was there by himself with the woman before him.

verses.en: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.pt: Então, erguendo-se Jesus e não vendo a ninguém senão a mulher, perguntou-lhe: Mulher, onde estão aqueles teus acusadores? Ninguém te condenou?
verses.en_web: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus got up, and seeing nobody but the woman, he said to her, Where are the men who said things against you? did no one give a decision against you?

verses.en: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.pt: Respondeu ela: Ninguém, Senhor. E disse-lhe Jesus: Nem eu te condeno; vai-te, e não peques mais.]
verses.en_web: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
verses.en_bbe: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, And I do not give a decision against you: go, and never do wrong again.]

verses.en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.pt: Então Jesus tornou a falar-lhes, dizendo: Eu sou a luz do mundo; quem me segue de modo algum andará em trevas, mas terá a luz da vida.
verses.en_web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
verses.en_bbe: Then again Jesus said to them, I am the light of the world; he who comes with me will not be walking in the dark but will have the light of life.

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os fariseus: Tu dás testemunho de ti mesmo; o teu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
verses.en_bbe: So the Pharisees said to him, The witness you give is about yourself: your witness is not true.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Ainda que eu dou testemunho de mim mesmo, o meu testemunho é verdadeiro; porque sei donde vim, e para onde vou; mas vós não sabeis donde venho, nem para onde vou.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, Even if I give witness about myself, my witness is true, because I have knowledge of where I came from and where I am going; but you have no knowledge of where I come from or of where I am going.

verses.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.pt: Vós julgais segundo a carne; eu a ninguém julgo.
verses.en_web: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
verses.en_bbe: You are judging from what you see; I am judging no man.

verses.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.pt: E, mesmo que eu julgue, o meu juízo é verdadeiro; porque não sou eu só, mas eu e o Pai que me enviou.
verses.en_web: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: Even if I am judging, my decision is right, because I am not by myself--with me is the Father who sent me.

verses.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.pt: Ora, na vossa lei está escrito que o testemunho de dois homens é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
verses.en_bbe: Even in your law it is said that the witness of two men is true.

verses.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.pt: Sou eu que dou testemunho de mim mesmo, e o Pai que me enviou, também dá testemunho de mim.
verses.en_web: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
verses.en_bbe: I give witness about myself and the Father who sent me gives witness about me.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.pt: Perguntavam-lhe, pois: Onde está teu pai? Jesus respondeu: Não me conheceis a mim, nem a meu Pai; se vós me conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai.
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
verses.en_bbe: Then they said to him, Where is your Father? Jesus said in answer, You have no knowledge of me or of my Father: if you had knowledge of me you would have knowledge of my Father.

verses.en: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.pt: Essas palavras proferiu Jesus no lugar do tesouro, quando ensinava no templo; e ninguém o prendeu, porque ainda não era chegada a sua hora.
verses.en_web: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said these words in the place where the offerings were stored, while he was teaching in the Temple: but no man took him because his time was still to come.

verses.en: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez: Eu me retiro; buscar-me- eis, e morrereis no vosso pecado. Para onde eu vou, vós não podeis ir.
verses.en_web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to them again, I am going away and you will be looking for me, but death will overtake you in your sins. It is not possible for you to come where I am going.

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.pt: Então diziam os judeus: Será que ele vai suicidar-se, pois diz: Para onde eu vou, vós não podeis ir?
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
verses.en_bbe: So the Jews said, Will he take his life? Is that why he says, Where I go it is not possible for you to come?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes ele: Vós sois de baixo, eu sou de cima; vós sois deste mundo, eu não sou deste mundo.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, You are of the earth; I am from heaven: you are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.pt: Por isso vos disse que morrereis em vossos pecados; porque, se não crerdes que eu sou, morrereis em vossos pecados.
verses.en_web: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
verses.en_bbe: For this reason I said to you that death will overtake you in your sins: for if you have not faith that I am he, death will come to you while you are in your sins.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.pt: Perguntavam-lhe então: Quem és tu? Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Exatamente o que venho dizendo que sou.
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
verses.en_bbe: Then they said to him, Who are you? Jesus said, What I said to you from the first.

verses.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.pt: Muitas coisas tenho que dizer e julgar acerca de vós; mas aquele que me enviou é verdadeiro; e o que dele ouvi, isso falo ao mundo.
verses.en_web: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
verses.en_bbe: I have much to say about you and against you: but he who sent me is true and what he has said to me I say to the world.

verses.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.pt: Eles não perceberam que lhes falava do Pai.
verses.en_web: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
verses.en_bbe: They did not see that his words were about the Father.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.pt: Prosseguiu, pois, Jesus: Quando tiverdes levantado o Filho do homem, então conhecereis que eu sou, e que nada faço de mim mesmo; mas como o Pai me ensinou, assim falo.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
verses.en_bbe: So Jesus said, When the Son of man has been lifted up by you, then it will be clear to you who I am, and that I do nothing of myself, but say as the Father gave me teaching.

verses.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.pt: E aquele que me enviou está comigo; não me tem deixado só; porque faço sempre o que é do seu agrado.
verses.en_web: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
verses.en_bbe: He who sent me is with me; he has not gone from me, because at all times I do the things which are pleasing to him.

verses.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.pt: Falando ele estas coisas, muitos creram nele.
verses.en_web: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
verses.en_bbe: When he said this a number came to have faith in him.

verses.en: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.pt: Dizia, pois, Jesus aos judeus que nele creram: Se vós permanecerdes na minha palavra, verdadeiramente sois meus discípulos;
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said to the Jews who had faith in him, If you keep my word, then you are truly my disciples;

verses.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.pt: e conhecereis a verdade, e a verdade vos libertará.
verses.en_web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.en_bbe: And you will have knowledge of what is true, and that will make you free.

verses.en: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: Somos descendentes de Abraão, e nunca fomos escravos de ninguém; como dizes tu: Sereis livres?
verses.en_web: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
verses.en_bbe: They said to him in answer, We are Abraham's seed and have never been any man's servant: why do you say, You will become free?

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.pt: Replicou-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que todo aquele que comete pecado é escravo do pecado.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
verses.en_bbe: And this was the answer Jesus gave them: Truly I say to you, Everyone who does evil is the servant of sin.

verses.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.pt: Ora, o escravo não fica para sempre na casa; o filho fica para sempre.
verses.en_web: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
verses.en_bbe: Now the servant does not go on living in the house for ever, but the son does.

verses.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.pt: Se, pois, o Filho vos libertar, verdadeiramente sereis livres.
verses.en_web: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.en_bbe: If then the son makes you free, you will be truly free.

verses.en: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.pt: Bem sei que sois descendência de Abraão; contudo, procurais matar-me, porque a minha palavra não encontra lugar em vós.
verses.en_web: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
verses.en_bbe: I am conscious that you are Abraham's seed; but you have a desire to put me to death because my word has no place in you.

verses.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.pt: Eu falo do que vi junto de meu Pai; e vós fazeis o que também ouvistes de vosso pai.
verses.en_web: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
verses.en_bbe: I say the things which I have seen in my Father's house: and you do the things which come to you from your father's house.

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: Nosso pai é Abraão. Disse-lhes Jesus: Se sois filhos de Abraão, fazei as obras de Abraão.
verses.en_web: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: In answer they said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children you would do what Abraham did.

verses.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.pt: Mas agora procurais matar-me, a mim que vos falei a verdade que de Deus ouvi; isso Abraão não fez.
verses.en_web: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
verses.en_bbe: But now you have a desire to put me to death, a man who has said to you what is true, as I had it from God: Abraham did not do that.

verses.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.pt: Vós fazeis as obras de vosso pai. Replicaram-lhe eles: Nós não somos nascidos de prostituição; temos um Pai, que é Deus.
verses.en_web: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
verses.en_bbe: You are doing the works of your father. They said to him, We are true sons of Abraham; we have one Father, who is God.

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Se Deus fosse o vosso Pai, vós me amaríeis, porque eu saí e vim de Deus; pois não vim de mim mesmo, mas ele me enviou.
verses.en_web: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, If God was your Father you would have love for me, because it was from God I came and am here. I did not come of myself, but he sent me.

verses.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.pt: Por que não compreendeis a minha linguagem? é porque não podeis ouvir a minha palavra.
verses.en_web: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
verses.en_bbe: Why are my words not clear to you? It is because your ears are shut to my teaching.

verses.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.pt: Vós tendes por pai o Diabo, e quereis satisfazer os desejos de vosso pai; ele é homicida desde o princípio, e nunca se firmou na verdade, porque nele não há verdade; quando ele profere mentira, fala do que lhe é próprio; porque é mentiroso, e pai da mentira.
verses.en_web: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
verses.en_bbe: You are the children of your father the Evil One and it is your pleasure to do his desires. From the first he was a taker of life; and he did not go in the true way because there is no true thing in him. When he says what is false, it is natural to him, for he is false and the father of what is false.

verses.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.pt: Mas porque eu digo a verdade, não me credes.
verses.en_web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
verses.en_bbe: But because I say what is true, you have no belief in me.

verses.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.pt: Quem dentre vós me convence de pecado? Se digo a verdade, por que não me credes?
verses.en_web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.en_bbe: Which of you is able truly to say that I am a sinner? If I say what is true, why have you no belief in me?

verses.en: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.pt: Quem é de Deus ouve as palavras de Deus; por isso vós não as ouvis, porque não sois de Deus.
verses.en_web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
verses.en_bbe: He who is a child of God gives ear to the words of God: your ears are not open to them because you are not from God.

verses.en: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe os judeus: Não dizemos com razão que és samaritano, e que tens demônio?
verses.en_web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
verses.en_bbe: The Jews said to him in answer, Are we not right in saying that you are of Samaria and have an evil spirit?

verses.en: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.pt: Jesus respondeu: Eu não tenho demônio; antes honro a meu Pai, e vós me desonrais.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
verses.en_bbe: And this was the answer of Jesus: I have not an evil spirit; but I give honour to my Father and you do not give honour to me.

verses.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.pt: Eu não busco a minha glória; há quem a busque, e julgue.
verses.en_web: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
verses.en_bbe: I, however, am not in search of glory for myself: there is One who is searching for it and he is judge.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que, se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca verá a morte.
verses.en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe os judeus: Agora sabemos que tens demônios. Abraão morreu, e também os profetas; e tu dizes: Se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca provará a morte!
verses.en_web: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
verses.en_bbe: The Jews said to him, Now we are certain that you have an evil spirit. Abraham is dead, and the prophets are dead; and you say, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.pt: Porventura és tu maior do que nosso pai Abraão, que morreu? Também os profetas morreram; quem pretendes tu ser?
verses.en_web: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
verses.en_bbe: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: who do you say that you are?

verses.en: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: Se eu me glorificar a mim mesmo, a minha glória não é nada; quem me glorifica é meu Pai, do qual vós dizeis que é o vosso Deus;
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, If I take glory for myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father who gives me glory, of whom you say that he is your God.

verses.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.pt: e vós não o conheceis; mas eu o conheço; e se disser que não o conheço, serei mentiroso como vós; mas eu o conheço, e guardo a sua palavra.
verses.en_web: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
verses.en_bbe: You have no knowledge of him, but I have knowledge of him; and if I said I have no knowledge of him I would be talking falsely like you: but I have full knowledge of him, and I keep his word.

verses.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.pt: Abraão, vosso pai, exultou por ver o meu dia; viu-o, e alegrou-se.
verses.en_web: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”
verses.en_bbe: Your father Abraham was full of joy at the hope of seeing my day: he saw it and was glad.

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Ainda não tens cinquenta anos, e viste Abraão?
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Jews said to him, You are not fifty years old; have you seen Abraham?

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que antes que Abraão existisse, eu sou.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, Before Abraham came into being, I am.

verses.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.pt: Então pegaram em pedras para lhe atirarem; mas Jesus ocultou-se, e saiu do templo.
verses.en_web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
verses.en_bbe: So they took up stones to send at him: but Jesus got secretly out of their way and went out of the Temple.
